explanation: The name of a city and tower that people built in an attempt to reach heaven, but God confused their language and scattered them over the earth.
The event where God confused human languages so they could not understand each other, leading to the scattering of the people and different language groups.
A mighty hunter and ruler mentioned in Genesis 11 who founded several cities, including Babel, and was a descendant of Noah's son Ham.
One of Noah's three sons who survived the flood together with his father. Shem is the ancestor of Semitic peoples and languages.
Shem's son and a descendant of Noah; he is part of the lineage leading to Abraham.
Father of Abram (later called Abraham), Nahor, and Haran. He was part of the lineage from Noah to Abraham.
Terah's son and Abram's brother. He died in Ur of the Chaldeans before the family moved to Canaan.
